Messages.Author: Gerentt
Messages.Body:
On Feb 2, 5:05 pm, "Frederick Scott" <nos...@no.spam.dot.com> wrote:
> "librarian" <aucti...@superfuncards.com> wrote in message


Nice powerful options for the (twice) damned.

If Evil Eye can be played as a reaction w/o tapping the reacting
vampire, there's no reason why you wouldn't want to keep an infernal
hanging around canceling action cards left-right-centre. And he
doesn't need to untap as well.

Shatter the Gates would attract aggro from everyone like no other,
probably more so than Smiling Jack.

Tend the Flock would see some usage if you're adding non-Baali
Infernals to your Baali crypt, otherwise Grooming the Protege (with
its non-requirement of untapped vampire) is as competitive. Which
leads me to suspect more non-Baali Infernals.

Are you aware (maybe not, given that you also didn't quote context in
your heated reply, so I can't even tell if it's my "attitude" or LSJ's
you're responding to) that some folks don't use a threaded newsreader,
and thus receive each post as its own individual message? Some folks
even get it in their email inboxes. That's 22 separate emails from
you.

This doesn't exist on googlegroups alone. It's a Usenet group.
That's why general netiquette applies.

I do appreciate the effort to post cards and track them down on Ebay.
It would have been *no more work* to paste them into a single reply
rather than 22, or however many it was, and post that. Or, if you
needed breaks or whatever (I'm not checking your timestamps here), to
post 4 messages that were each 5 times as long, rather than 40
individual messages. The fact that Googlegroups wouldn't let you
should have been a clue that what you were doing maybe wasn't the most
considerate way of doing it.

- D.J.
